title: Understanding Linearly Separable Datasets
text: A linearly separable dataset is one where you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) that separates the data points of different classes. Think about how this might affect the number of solutions for a model.

title: Exploring Logistic Regression Solutions
text: In logistic regression, the goal is to find the best-fitting model to describe the relationship between the dependent variable and one or more independent variables. Consider how the nature of the dataset might influence the number of optimal solutions.
